what: GitHub Actions minutes per workflow run, billed per job on ubuntu-latest, before and after the round 3 phase 15 rules (scripts/ci/changed_areas.sh, scripts/ci/already_tested.sh, caches).

before.event: push to main after pull request 24 (an identical tree had just passed as the pull request)
before.note: every phase ran the whole workflow twice: once on the pull request and once more on the push to main

rules: a push to main whose tree already passed as a pull request head runs only the detect job and the secret scan
a pull request runs a client job only when that client's files (or something shared) changed, and the backend jobs only when backend files (or something shared) changed
superseded runs are cancelled (concurrency, unchanged); pip, npm, Gradle and the Next.js build cache are kept between runs
after.note: filled in from the first runs on the new workflow: the phase 15 pull request and the push to main that merges it
